Daily Devotional

September 5

6 Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre. 7 Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows. (Psalms 45:6-7 KJV)

These verses were quoted in the New Testament (Hebrews 1:8-9), and applied to Jesus, so we see that these are prophetic scriptures referring to Jesus. You will also notice that these verses refer to Jesus, or the Messiah, as God, making it very clear that Jesus was God in the flesh (John 1:1). Jesus will be on the throne forever and ever, Hallelujah! We will be right there with Him at the throne, if born again and saved by obeying Jesus (Hebrews 5:9).

Jesus loves righteousness and hates wickedness, and we need to be the same way in what we love and hate. It is not good enough to just verbally talk about living righteous and hating wickedness, but our lives need to reflect that also. Our fruit we bear in our lives says much more than what we profess with our words, as we need to be doers of the Word and not hearers only (James 1:22). Notice that Jesus was anointed with the oil of gladness above all others. To think that He was glad to come and bear our sins and redeem us shows just how much He truly loves us, and if we can just comprehend the awesome love of God, we will be in absolute love with Him. Love conquers all things, and God is love (1 John 4:8).

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
